name: Trol'kalar
summary: At Trollbane's Tomb, Trol'kalar slips free of its stone sheath as the light fades. You carry the sword to Zengu in Hammerfall.

sections.title: A Sword Set Free
sections.body: At Trollbane's Tomb, you find Trol'kalar free of its stone sheath. You carry the sheathed sword to Zengu in Hammerfall, in the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: What Zengu Says
sections.body: Zengu says Strom and Arathor's forces preyed on the trolls for generations. Now his people hold their greatest weapon, and the slow advance into Zul'Gurub's humid forests will no longer be a struggle. The Darkspear trolls are in your debt, he says. He will deliver the sword to Nimboya at Grom'gol.

faq.q: Where does Trol'kalar need to go?
faq.answer: Carry the sword, still in its stone sheath, to Zengu in Hammerfall, in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where do I find the sword?
faq.answer: Find the sword at Trollbane's Tomb, where the fading light has freed it from its stone sheath.
This follows the earlier Trol'kalar step and is the last step in the long chain.
